description: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) emissions saved per kilogram of material recycled compared to producing from virgin materials. Factors are based on EPA WARM model and environmental research, mapped to EcoKuha's accepted materials.
unit: kg CO₂ saved per kg material recycled

pet.note: PET plastic. High energy savings from avoiding virgin PET production.

pet_bottles.note: PET bottles (water, soda). High energy savings.

pet_bottles_clear.note: Clear PET bottles. Premium quality recycling.

pet_bottles_colored.note: Colored PET bottles. Slightly lower than clear.

mixed_plastic.note: Mixed plastic types (HDPE, LDPE, PP). Average recycling value.

assorted_plastic.note: Mixed plastic types. Average recycling value.

kola_plastic.note: Low-grade plastic films. Lower recycling efficiency.

aluminum.note: Aluminum. Highest recycling benefit - 95% energy savings.

aluminum_cans.note: Aluminum cans. Highest recycling benefit - 95% energy savings vs virgin production.

kaldero.note: Aluminum pots and cookware. High aluminum recycling value.

assorted_aluminum.note: Mixed aluminum items. Slightly lower than pure aluminum.

copper.note: Pure copper. High energy savings from avoiding mining and smelting.

copper_radiator.note: Copper radiators from AC units. High copper content (~70-80% copper).

brass.note: Brass fittings and products. Copper-zinc alloy.

stainless_steel.note: Stainless steel items. Contains chromium and nickel.

iron.note: Iron scrap. Standard ferrous metal recycling.

steel_iron.note: Steel/Iron scrap. Standard ferrous metal recycling.

tin.note: Tin materials. Steel with tin coating.

tin_can.note: Tin cans (food cans). Steel with tin coating.

aluminum_radiator.note: Aluminum radiators. High recycling value, ~80% aluminum content.

light_metals.note: Light mixed metals. Combination of aluminum and other light alloys.

white_paper.note: White office paper. High quality recycling.

white_bondpaper.note: White bond paper. High quality recycling.

assorted_paper.note: Mixed paper types. Lower quality recycling.

clear_glass_bottles.note: Clear glass bottles. Standard glass recycling.

softdrinks_bottle.note: Softdrink bottles (Pepsi, Coke, 8-12oz). Standard glass recycling.

beer_bottle.note: Beer bottles (RedHorse, San Mig). Standard glass recycling.

liquor_bottle.note: Liquor bottles (Tanduay, Emperador, Kulafu). Standard glass recycling.

condiment_bottle.note: Ketchup and condiment bottles. Mixed glass quality.

mobile_phones.note: Mobile phones. Contains precious metals and prevents toxic waste.

computer_parts.note: Computer parts. High value due to precious metal content.

motherboard.note: Computer motherboards. High value due to precious metal content.

tv_board.note: TV circuit boards. Contains precious metals (gold, silver).

cpu.note: Computer processors. Contains gold and other valuable materials.

cables_wires.note: Electronic cables and wires. Copper recovery.

batteries.note: Batteries. Lead recovery and prevents pollution.

car_battery.note: Lead-acid car batteries. Prevents lead pollution.

airconditioner.note: Air conditioning units. Refrigerant recovery and metal recycling.

split_type_aircon.note: Split-type air conditioners. Refrigerant and metal recovery.

refrigerator.note: Refrigerators. Refrigerant recovery and steel recycling.

retro_tv.note: CRT televisions. Contains valuable metals and prevents toxic materials.

washing_machine.note: Washing machines. Mostly steel and motor components.

bakal_solid.note: Solid iron/steel scrap. High-quality ferrous metal.

bakal_assorted.note: Mixed iron/steel grades. Average of various types.

alloy.note: Iron alloys. Contains additional metals (chromium, nickel).

tires.note: Vehicle tires. Rubber recycling and energy recovery.

lata.note: Tin cans (food containers). Steel with coating.

default.note: Fallback for unspecified materials. Conservative estimate.

sources: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - Waste Reduction Model (WARM)
WRAP (Waste & Resources Action Programme) - UK Environmental Research
European Environment Agency - Life Cycle Assessment Data
EcoKuha Material Database - Based on Philippine junkshop material types
notes: Carbon factors represent gross savings (avoided emissions from virgin production minus recycling process emissions)
Actual savings may vary based on local recycling infrastructure and transportation distances
These are conservative estimates - some studies show higher values
Aluminum has the highest factor because virgin production requires bauxite mining and energy-intensive smelting
Material names are matched case-insensitively with underscores/spaces normalized
